description: Une table et un ballon.
---

plateau2 = point(8, 3, visible=faux)
plateau3 = point(8, 3.5, visible=faux)
plateau4 = point(3, 3.5, visible=faux)
plateau = polygone(plateau1, plateau2, plateau3, plateau4, couleur="noir", remplissage="marron", opacite_fond=1)
pa1 = point(3.3, 0.5, visible=faux)
pa2 = point(3.7, 0.5, visible=faux)
pa3 = point(3.7, 3, visible=faux)
pa4 = point(3.3, 3, visible=faux)

pb1 = point(7.3, 0.5, visible=faux)
pb2 = point(7.7, 0.5, visible=faux)
pb3 = point(7.7, 3, visible=faux)
pb4 = point(7.3, 3, visible=faux)
pb = polygone(pb1, pb2, pb3, pb4, couleur="noir", remplissage="marron", opacite_fond=1)
